_readme: Rules for Tools > Check Level. To change them, use 'Edit rules...' in the Check Level window: it creates a copy in your user data folder, and any key you set there overrides this file. Severity is error, warning or info. Every check can be turned off with "enabled": false.

warp_destination_missing._entrance_types: Entrance types the player can go into: door, pipes, mini pipes, vine, pipe towards the screen.

sprite_outside_zone._margin: How far outside a zone (in level units, 16 per tile) a sprite may be before it is reported.

id_reference_missing._id_types: ID fields (id_type in spritedata.xml) that must point at something that exists in the same area. ID 0 is the usual 'not set' value.

id_used_once._id_types: Linking IDs that do nothing unless at least two sprites share them.

sprites._level_ends: Goal Pole, boss fights and their controllers.
sprites._ground_enemies: Walking enemies that fall if nothing is below them.
